-- DCL LOA 90 Day - SQL Server audit query
-- Exported from ATLAS Align on 2026-11-16. 20 enabled steps; disabled steps are left out.
-- Generated from Developer Logic. Review the code and test it on sample data before relying on the results.
--
-- Review:
--   - Steps 5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 6.1, 6.2, 6.3, 6.4, 6.5, 6.6 are nested under another step. Their code runs on every row; add the parent step's condition if they should only apply to the parent's matching rows.
--
-- Source tables (replace these names if your tables are named differently):
--   - [sap.hi0256]
--   - [sap.currency]
--   - [workday.headcount_data_position]
--   - [angej055.ent_sep]
--   - [HI0256_Maseke]
--   - [sensitive_churnover]

WITH
-- Step 1: Reference sap.hi0256
-- Reference source file "sap.hi0256" as "sap.hi0256":
step_1 AS (
  SELECT * FROM [sap.hi0256] AS [sap.hi0256]
),

-- Step 2: Reference sap.currency
-- Reference source file "sap.currency" as "sap.currency":
step_2 AS (
  SELECT * FROM [sap.currency] AS [sap.currency]
),

-- Step 3: Reference workday.headcount_data_position
-- Reference source file "workday.headcount_data_position" as "workday.headcount_data_position":
step_3 AS (
  SELECT * FROM [workday.headcount_data_position] AS [workday.headcount_data_position]
),

-- Step 4: Reference angej055.ent_sep
-- Reference source file "angej055.ent_sep" as "angej055.ent_sep":
step_4 AS (
  SELECT * FROM [angej055.ent_sep] AS [angej055.ent_sep]
),

-- Step 5: Reference HI0256_Maseke
-- Reference source file "HI0256_Maseke" as "sap.hi0256":
step_5 AS (
  SELECT * FROM [HI0256_Maseke] AS [sap.hi0256]
),

-- Step 5.1 (THEN branch): Format Field
-- Format file "sap.hi0256" column "persno" as .
step_5_1 AS (
  SELECT CAST([persno] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS [persno],
         [workday_employee_id],
         [position_number],
         [workday_position_id],
         [start_date_it00],
         [end_date_it00],
         [action_type],
         [action_type_text],
         [action_reason_number],
         [action_reason_text],
         [employment_status_number],
         [employment_status_text]
  FROM step_5
),

-- Step 5.2 (THEN branch): IF / THEN
-- IF file "sap.hi0256" column "personnel_area" is not equal to ""2450", "3357", "3358", "3359", "3360", "3361", "3362", "3744", "3745", "3981", "3982", "3983", "3984", "4024"" THEN do not display record.
-- Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
step_5_2 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM step_5_1
  WHERE NOT ([personnel_area] <> '"2450", "3357", "3358", "3359", "3360", "3361", "3362", "3744", "3745", "3981", "3982", "3983", "3984", "4024"')
),

-- Step 5.3 (THEN branch): IF / THEN
-- IF file "sap.hi0256" column "employment_status_number" is not equal to "1" THEN do not display record.
-- Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
step_5_3 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM step_5_2
  WHERE NOT ([employment_status_number] <> '1')
),

-- Step 6: Reference sensitive_churnover
-- Reference source file "sensitive_churnover" as "sensitive_churnover":
step_6 AS (
  SELECT * FROM [sensitive_churnover] AS [sensitive_churnover]
),

-- Step 6.1 (THEN branch): Create Column
-- Create new column "Days on Leave" using expression: REPORT DATE - start_date.
-- Note: The expression is free text and is copied as written. Review it before running.
step_6_1 AS (
  SELECT REPORT DATE - start_date AS [Days on Leave]
  FROM step_6
),

-- Step 6.2 (THEN branch): Format Field
-- Format file "sensitive_churnover" column "persno" as .
step_6_2 AS (
  SELECT *, CAST(CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS [persno]
  FROM step_6_1
),

-- Step 6.3 (THEN branch): Format Field
-- Format file "sensitive_churnover" column "act_type" as text.
step_6_3 AS (
  SELECT *, CAST(CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS [act_type]
  FROM step_6_2
),

-- Step 6.4 (THEN branch): IF / THEN
-- IF file "sensitive_churnover" column "act_type" is not equal to "'Start__LOA_with_Pay', 'Start__LOA_without_P', 'Start_LOA'" THEN do not display record.
-- Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
step_6_4 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM step_6_3
  WHERE NOT ([act_type] <> '''Start__LOA_with_Pay'', ''Start__LOA_without_P'', ''Start_LOA''')
),

-- Step 6.5 (THEN branch): Sort Records
-- Sort records by file "sensitive_churnover" column "start_date" in Descending order.
-- The sort order is applied in the final SELECT (and to later Remove Duplicates steps).

-- Step 6.6 (THEN branch): Remove Duplicates
-- Identify rows where all values match across these columns: file "sensitive_churnover" column "persno", remove duplicates and keep the first record.
step_6_6_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [persno] ORDER BY [start_date] DESC) AS [Duplicate Rank]
  FROM step_6_4
),

step_6_6 AS (
  SELECT [Days on Leave],
         [persno],
         [act_type]
  FROM step_6_6_ranked
  WHERE [Duplicate Rank] = 1
),

-- Step 7: Join
-- Join file "sap.hi0256" column "persno" and file "sensitive_churnover" column "persno".
step_7 AS (
  SELECT [sap.hi0256].*,
         [sensitive_churnover].[Days on Leave] AS [Days on Leave_sensitive_churnover]
  FROM step_6_6 AS [sap.hi0256]
  LEFT JOIN [sensitive_churnover] AS [sensitive_churnover]
    ON [sap.hi0256].[persno] = [sensitive_churnover].[persno]
),

-- Step 8: Create Column
-- Create new blank column "Error Message".
step_8 AS (
  SELECT *, NULL AS [Error Message]
  FROM step_7
),

-- Step 9: IF / THEN
-- IF file "sensitive_churnover" column "start_date" is greater than "run_date" THEN do not display record.
-- Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
step_9 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM step_8
  WHERE NOT ([start_date] > 'run_date')
),

-- Step 10: IF / THEN
-- IF new column "Days on Leave" is greater than "90" THEN display text response "Over 90 Days on Leave" in new column "Error Message".
step_10 AS (
  SELECT [Days on Leave],
         [persno],
         [act_type],
         [Days on Leave_sensitive_churnover],
         CASE WHEN [Days on Leave] > 90 THEN CONCAT_WS('||', NULLIF([Error Message], ''), 'Over 90 Days on Leave') ELSE [Error Message] END AS [Error Message]
  FROM step_9
),

-- Step 11: IF / THEN
-- IF new column "Error Message" is blank/null THEN do not display record.
-- Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
step_11 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM step_10
  WHERE NOT (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM([Error Message])), '') IS NULL)
)

SELECT *
FROM step_11
ORDER BY [start_date] DESC;

# Source files to read, one per source the audit uses (.csv, .txt, .xlsx, .xls).
SOURCE_PATHS = {
    "sap.hi0256": "",
    "sap.currency": "",
    "workday.headcount_data_position": "",
    "angej055.ent_sep": "",
    "sensitive_churnover": "",
}

# File to write the audit results to (.csv or .xlsx).
OUTPUT_PATH = ""

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reading and writing files
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
EXCEL_EXTENSIONS = {".xlsx", ".xlsm", ".xls"}
TEXT_EXTENSIONS = {".csv", ".txt"}


def check_paths():
    """Stops with a message when a required path is blank or a file is missing."""
    blank = [f"SOURCE_PATHS[{name!r}]" for name, path in SOURCE_PATHS.items() if not path]
    if not OUTPUT_PATH:
        blank.append("OUTPUT_PATH")
    if blank:
        sys.exit("Set these paths at the top of the script: " + ", ".join(blank))
    missing = [path for path in SOURCE_PATHS.values() if not Path(path).is_file()]
    if missing:
        sys.exit("These source files were not found: " + ", ".join(missing))


def read_source(path):
    """Reads a source file, choosing the reader from its extension."""
    extension = Path(path).suffix.lower()
    if extension in EXCEL_EXTENSIONS:
        return pd.read_excel(path)
    if extension in TEXT_EXTENSIONS:
        return pd.read_csv(path)
    sys.exit(f"{path}: use a .csv, .txt, .xlsx or .xls file.")


def write_output(df, path):
    """Writes the results, choosing the writer from the file extension."""
    extension = Path(path).suffix.lower()
    if extension in EXCEL_EXTENSIONS:
        df.to_excel(path, index=False)
    elif extension in TEXT_EXTENSIONS:
        df.to_csv(path, index=False)
    else:
        sys.exit(f"{path}: OUTPUT_PATH must end in .csv or .xlsx.")


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Audit logic
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def run_audit(sources):
    """Runs the audit steps in order and returns the results."""
    # Step 1: Reference sap.hi0256
    # Reference source file "sap.hi0256" as "sap.hi0256":
    df = sources["sap.hi0256"].copy()

    # Step 2: Reference sap.currency
    # Reference source file "sap.currency" as "sap.currency":
    df = sources["sap.currency"].copy()

    # Step 3: Reference workday.headcount_data_position
    # Reference source file "workday.headcount_data_position" as "workday.headcount_data_position":
    df = sources["workday.headcount_data_position"].copy()

    # Step 4: Reference angej055.ent_sep
    # Reference source file "angej055.ent_sep" as "angej055.ent_sep":
    df = sources["angej055.ent_sep"].copy()

    # Step 5: Reference HI0256_Maseke
    # Reference source file "HI0256_Maseke" as "sap.hi0256":
    df = sources["sap.hi0256"].copy()

    # Step 5.1 (THEN branch): Format Field
    # Format file "sap.hi0256" column "persno" as .
    df["persno"] = df["persno"].astype("string")

    # Step 5.2 (THEN branch): IF / THEN
    # IF file "sap.hi0256" column "personnel_area" is not equal to ""2450", "3357", "3358", "3359", "3360", "3361", "3362", "3744", "3745", "3981", "3982", "3983", "3984", "4024"" THEN do not display record.
    # Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
    mask = df["personnel_area"] != "\"2450\", \"3357\", \"3358\", \"3359\", \"3360\", \"3361\", \"3362\", \"3744\", \"3745\", \"3981\", \"3982\", \"3983\", \"3984\", \"4024\""
    df = df[~mask]

    # Step 5.3 (THEN branch): IF / THEN
    # IF file "sap.hi0256" column "employment_status_number" is not equal to "1" THEN do not display record.
    # Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
    mask = df["employment_status_number"] != "1"
    df = df[~mask]

    # Step 6: Reference sensitive_churnover
    # Reference source file "sensitive_churnover" as "sensitive_churnover":
    df = sources["sensitive_churnover"].copy()

    # Step 6.1 (THEN branch): Create Column
    # Create new column "Days on Leave" using expression: REPORT DATE - start_date.
    # Note: The expression is free text and is copied as written. Review it before running.
    df["Days on Leave"] = REPORT DATE - start_date

    # Step 6.2 (THEN branch): Format Field
    # Format file "sensitive_churnover" column "persno" as .
    df["persno"] = df["persno"].astype("string")

    # Step 6.3 (THEN branch): Format Field
    # Format file "sensitive_churnover" column "act_type" as text.
    df["act_type"] = df["act_type"].astype("string")

    # Step 6.4 (THEN branch): IF / THEN
    # IF file "sensitive_churnover" column "act_type" is not equal to "'Start__LOA_with_Pay', 'Start__LOA_without_P', 'Start_LOA'" THEN do not display record.
    # Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
    mask = df["act_type"] != "'Start__LOA_with_Pay', 'Start__LOA_without_P', 'Start_LOA'"
    df = df[~mask]

    # Step 6.5 (THEN branch): Sort Records
    # Sort records by file "sensitive_churnover" column "start_date" in Descending order.
    df = df.sort_values(["start_date"], ascending=[False], kind="stable")

    # Step 6.6 (THEN branch): Remove Duplicates
    # Identify rows where all values match across these columns: file "sensitive_churnover" column "persno", remove duplicates and keep the first record.
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["persno"], keep="first")

    # Step 7: Join
    # Join file "sap.hi0256" column "persno" and file "sensitive_churnover" column "persno".
    df = df.merge(sources["sensitive_churnover"], how="left", left_on="persno", right_on="persno", suffixes=("", "_sensitive_churnover"))

    # Step 8: Create Column
    # Create new blank column "Error Message".
    df["Error Message"] = pd.NA

    # Step 9: IF / THEN
    # IF file "sensitive_churnover" column "start_date" is greater than "run_date" THEN do not display record.
    # Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
    mask = df["start_date"] > "run_date"
    df = df[~mask]

    # Step 10: IF / THEN
    # IF new column "Days on Leave" is greater than "90" THEN display text response "Over 90 Days on Leave" in new column "Error Message".
    mask = df["Days on Leave"] > 90
    df["Error Message"] = df.get("Error Message", "")
    existing = df.loc[mask, "Error Message"].fillna("").astype(str)
    df.loc[mask, "Error Message"] = existing.where(existing == "", existing + "||") + "Over 90 Days on Leave"

    # Step 11: IF / THEN
    # IF new column "Error Message" is blank/null THEN do not display record.
    # Note: Do Not Display - Keep only rows that do not match this condition.
    mask = df["Error Message"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().eq("")
    df = df[~mask]

    return df


def main():
    check_paths()
    sources = {name: read_source(path) for name, path in SOURCE_PATHS.items()}
    results = run_audit(sources)
    write_output(results, OUTPUT_PATH)
    print(f"Wrote {len(results):,} rows to {OUTPUT_PATH}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
